name: Rob Warner
headline: Senior Director, Professional Services
location: Baltimore City County, Maryland, United States
about:
Senior Professional Services executive with an active TS/SCI FSP, enabling direct engagement across the most sensitive IC and DoD programs.
Over 15 years building and leading PS organizations at product companies and system integrators, I've doubled portfolio bookings to $70M+ annually, transformed delivery models, and developed lasting executive relationships with CIOs, SES officials, and GS-15 government leaders across DoD, the Intelligence Community, and civilian federal agencies.
I operate at the intersection of business growth and delivery excellence — validating deal viability before contract execution, maintaining financial governance across portfolio and program levels, and converting successful delivery into expansion and long-term partnerships.
An active practitioner of AI-assisted workflows, I apply tools such as NotebookLM, Gemini, and LLMs to accelerate RFP/SOW analysis, identify delivery risk and remediation paths, and support portfolio monitoring; I'm actively expanding AI-assisted tooling across my team's delivery operations.
What drives me: building the organizations and cultures where talented people do the best work and contributing to programs that genuinely matter.

experiences.description:
Led the National Security Professional Services portfolio across DoD, Intelligence Community, Department of State, and Department of Energy. Accountable for bookings growth and delivery excellence across a portfolio of federal agency engagements.

• Doubled portfolio bookings to $70M+ in annual bookings; exceeded most recent fiscal year target by 25% while operating shorthanded
• Led PS content for a 10-year, $5.6B Army IDIQ — including pricing justification, new implementation labor categories, and a cleared-personnel addendum; adopted by other DoD organizations
• Transformed a key SI engagement from T&M subcontractor to fixed-price Prime, resulting in a $7M/year contract win requiring executive alignment and a shift in how the customer measured value
• Built and developed a team of 15 PS delivery and growth leaders; received FY26 Exceptional performance rating (Top 6% company-wide) — awarded highest-performing ProServ portfolio in AMERS US PubSec for FY26
• Applied AI tools (NotebookLM) to accelerate RFP/RFQ analysis, proposal compliance assessment, and pre-sales scope risk identification

Led go-to-market strategy for Red Hat Professional Services and Customer Success across the Intelligence Community. Drove year-over-year growth, created new IC-approved service offerings, and managed talent acquisition and retention for personnel in classified environments.
